mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP indicates a growing economy, which leads to higher consumer spending and increased demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with strong GDP growth, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to decreased borrowing and spending, and ultimately resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances with high federal funds rates, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.
